description: ASTROGENIX is a team of passionate innovators focused on space technology, AI, and healthcare innovation. Our goal is to develop a smart Health Monitoring App that makes health tracking easier and more accessible. We believe in creativity, teamwork, and using technology to solve real-world problems. We welcome enthusiastic team members skilled in Python, AI/ML, app development, UI/UX design, and data analysis. Together, we aim to innovate, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact!
